elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, but there is no express duty to defend.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client and its affiliates against “all claims,” which encompasses third-party claims, although the clause is not limited to them.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause b(ii) covers allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services, materials, or deliverables infringe or misappropriate enumerated intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause b(iii) expressly covers TrueLink’s breach of any applicable law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause b(iv) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause b(v) expressly covers TrueLink’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no claim-notice requirement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause does not allocate control of the defence.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no cooperation obligation.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Client’s indemnity also covers any breach of the Agreement, specified acts or omissions affecting other agreements, and injury or property damage relating to products, services, or information from the Web Site.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client against all claims arising from allegations that the identified services, materials, or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual-property rights, encompassing third-party claims.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion appears, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion appears, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion appears, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides no procure, modify, or replace remedies.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides no contingent refund remedy.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees super-cap is stated in the rendered clause.
